change.summary: Replace the Q3 native-attention quarantine with quant-axis exact GDN and full-attention bulk plugins.
change.gdn: A state-parallel K2 recurrent kernel preserves the resident c=1 F32 reduction association, paired with a decode-order Q/K preparation kernel.
change.attention: The bulk prefill plugin uses the resident 256-thread dense schedule below context 1024, row-batched warp split-K for contexts 1024..4095, and row-batched grouped-GQA split-K at 4096+.
change.fallbacks: Generic gguf_qwen35 prefill kernels and token-serial/native attention remain available; no backend/quant conditional was added to engine/model dispatch.

full_4096_serial_vs_bulk.procedure: One Qwen35GGUFResidentSession runs session.prefill(tokens, use_bulk=False, return_logits=True), then session.prefill(tokens, use_bulk=True, bulk_attention_mode='bulk', return_logits=True), and compares the complete float32 logit vectors with scripts.qwen35_gguf_bulk_parity._logit_comparison.

rocprof.command: LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/tmp/hipengine-roctx-sdk-override-gguf-eager:<ROCm-sysdeps> HIP_VISIBLE_DEVICES=1 HIPENGINE_HIP_ARCH=gfx1100 HIPENGINE_COMPILER_VERSION_FILE=/tmp/hipengine-hipcc-version-q3.txt HIPENGINE_REQUIRE_CACHED_BUILD=1 PYTHONPATH=. rocprofv3 --kernel-trace --selected-regions true --output-format csv -d /tmp/hipengine-q3-exact-fastbulk-4k-profile-20260720-130719 -o q3-exact-fastbulk-4k-prefill -- python3 scripts/qwen35_gguf_bench.py --model /models/gguf/Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-UD-Q3_K_M.gguf --quant gguf_ud_q3_k_m --token-id 9707 --prompt-length 4096 --decode-tokens 0 --warmup-decode-tokens 0 --warmup-runs 0 --measured-runs 1 --persistent-session --force-bulk-prefill --bulk-prefill-attention-mode bulk --no-use-wmma-prefill --no-use-gemv-decode --graph-replay-decode --graph-steps-per-replay 1 --rocprof-selected-region prefill --compiler-version-file /tmp/hipengine-hipcc-version-q3.txt --require-cached-build

notes: The 512 and 4K throughput values are single-run correctness-gated promotion measurements, not a multi-run final optimization scoreboard.
The exact serial comparison is the resident token-serial oracle; the previous native-attention row-bulk default was approximately 17-20 tok/s in retained Q3 rows.
The 4K benchmark command uses a repeated token for rocprof while the strict serial-vs-bulk gate uses the listed mixed eight-token pattern.
Raw profiler CSV and transient parity JSON remain under /tmp and are intentionally not committed.
